acquisition: One strip (pl:strip_id): a pass is delivered as a run of short scenes, and the scenes of one strip at a site count as one acquisition.
footprint: The union of the strip's scenes that touch the site.
cloud: For each scene, averaged over the scenes at the site by their area there; each scene's value covers the whole scene.
scope: Planet's own catalog. CSDA also holds PlanetScope data (CSDA STAC planet collection), which this tab does not check yet, so In CSDA is not shown.
